question: C₂H₅OH is the chemical formula of _______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**ethanol.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **C₂H₅OH **is the chemical formula of **ethanol**, which is a **clear, colorless liquid** that is used as a** fuel, solvent, **and in the production of** alcoholic beverages.**
 
• Ethanol is also known as **ethyl alcohol or grain alcohol** and is produced by the fermentation of sugars in** grains, fruits, and vegetables.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Propene**, also known as **propylene,** is a **colorless gas **that is used in the production of** plastics, solvents, and gasoline additives.**
 
• **Methane** is a **colorless, odorless gas** that is the main component of **natural gas** and is used as a fuel for** heating and cooking.**
 
• **Butyne,** also known as **butyne-1, **is a **colorless gas** that is used in the production of **rubber, plastics, and pharmaceuticals.**
